source_matrix: Parras (2026), revised edition, matrix p. 59 (reference supplied in supervisor corrections); original transcription source identified in provenance.json
source_summary: Author-supplied SpinQ_Bell_state_experiments.csv, received 2026-10-19; revised-edition reference: Fig. 6.3.4, p. 61 (supplied in supervisor corrections)
transformation: Negative eigenvalues set to zero; remaining eigenvalues divided by their sum
limitations: One rounded matrix; not 39 complete matrices
No defensible match of the matrix to a summary Experiment_ID
Raw matrix is not PSD and has a negative 01 population
PSD clipping/renormalisation is a sensitivity choice, not recovered measurement data or SGS projection
All 39 reported pairs violate F <= (1+C)/2 under the stated squared Bell-fidelity convention; descriptive use only
Revised-edition page references and experimental summary are supplied in supervisor corrections; revised PDF identity/hash not independently verified
Model epsilon=1e-5 is illustrative, not the physical polarization reported for each nucleus
Temp_Error is half the endpoint difference, not an estimated standard error
No uncertainty on matrix elements and no raw tomography files
No new hardware acquisition or human listening test
revised_reference_verification: Page/figure references and experimental summary supplied in supervisor corrections; revised PDF identity and hash not independently verified

summary_consistency.fidelity_convention: Squared fidelity to the ideal Phi+ Bell state
summary_consistency.interpretation: Reported pairs are used descriptively, not as independently validated physical states. Their incompatibility with this necessary bound is consistent with the linear-reconstruction caution identified in the supervisor corrections; the original CSV values are not altered.

fidelity_convention: Squared Bell fidelity is used for comparison; psd_fidelity_root is also explicitly provided as its square root.
